full_text: LETTERS TO LORD IRWIN. (Just  as Mahatma Gandhi started his mass  Non-co- operation Movement in the year  1922  giving a timely vjaming to Lord Reading in the form of an appeal, sometimes termed as ultimatum similarly in March  193c before embarking on his Civil Disobedience Campaign Gandhiji sent a letter—again of the r^ture of an appeal and an ultimatum, combined in one —to  Lord Irwin, the Viceroy of India at that time. Gandhiji wrote two letters to Lord Irwin,—one at the time of launching the Civil Disobedience Campaign and the other sometime before his arrest.)
